test_title: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 12 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A, B, C, D, Q, R and S are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre of the table. Q sits to the immediate right of D. Only three people sit between Q and S, when counted from the left of Q. Only three people sit between D and C. A sits to the immediate right of R. How many people sit between D and R, when counted from the right of R?
solution: Given: A, B, C, D, Q, R and S are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre of the table 1) Q sits to the immediate right of D. 2) Only three people sit between Q and S, when counted from the left of Q. 3) Only three people sit between D and C. 4) A sits to the immediate right of R.
